description.narrative: Afropa Liberia Inc. (Afropa or the Company) is a leading beverage and food distribution company in Liberia. The proposed Project is a $20 million debt financing package, comprised of a $10 million A-loan from IFC and a $10 million loan from the IDA20 IFC-MIGA Private Sector Windows Blended Finance Facility (IDA PSW-BFF), aiming to finance the expansion of the Company in Liberia and Sierra Leone. The Company is implementing a $33 million project, aiming to (i) increase its water bottling capacity in Liberia; (ii) refurbish a newly acquired water bottling plant in Sierra Leone; and (iii) finance working capital needs (the Project).

IFC expects the Project to enhance the economy through job creation and added value from its expanded operations. This increased capacity will directly address Sierra Leone and Liberia's pressing need for safe and clean drinking water. Moreover, the Project will have environment impacts in terms of increased water and energy use efficiency. Beyond the Project-level impact, IFC anticipates the Project will contribute to increasing the competitiveness of the bottled water market by exerting competitive pressures on other bottled water producers in Liberia and Sierra Leone to optimize their cost structures and improve the distribution model and operation efficiency.
